title: Moroccan Stew with Zaalouk Beans
description: A hearty, flavorful stew originating from Morocco, made with tender beans and a rich, aromatic spice blend.

ingredients.name: Moroccan Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: available at most grocery stores or online

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the lovely long beans and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add the molten zaalouk beans, Moroccan spice blend, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the beans are tender.
Stir in chopped fresh parsley, if using.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Serve over rice, couscous, or with crusty bread for a filling meal.
